title: Flat wall insulating concrete form (ICF) systems.
officialText:
Insulating concrete form material used for forming flat concrete walls shall conform to ASTM E 2634.

1904.1. General. Concrete shall be designed and proportioned to comply with the durability, strength, exposure, and other requirements as specified in Section 4.1 of ACI 318 and Sections 1904.2 through 1904.5 of this chapter.
